title: UX Friction Flow Audit Input
description: A structured description of a candidate UX flow, sufficient for scripts/friction_audit.mjs to mechanically check the 5 failure modes and mobile/touch/feedback quality gates from SKILL.md. Not a substitute for real-user validation.

steps.description: The ordered steps of the flow being audited, e.g. the screens/states of a checkout or onboarding.

label.description: Human-readable name of the step, e.g. 'Shipping address form'.

cognitiveState.description: The user's cognitive state during this step, matching the Primary Decision Tree in SKILL.md.

timeSeconds.description: Expected or observed wall-clock time to complete this step, including any wait/processing time.

chunks.description: Number of distinct mental chunks (fields, decisions, or facts to hold in working memory) this step requires.

autoSaves.description: Whether progress made in this step is persisted automatically without an explicit save action.

showsProgress.description: Whether this step gives the user visible feedback about system state during any wait (spinner, progress bar, time estimate).

contextPreserved.description: Whether the user's place and prior input in this step survive an interruption (e.g. backgrounding the app, a notification, a tab switch).

primaryActionObviousWithin3s.description: Whether a first-time user can identify the primary next action within 3 seconds of arriving at the flow's entry point.

touchTargetsMinPx.description: The smallest interactive touch target size used anywhere in the flow, in CSS pixels.

worksAt320pxNoHscroll.description: Whether the flow renders correctly at a 320px viewport width with no horizontal scrolling.

feedbackWithin100ms.description: Whether every user action (click, tap, keypress) receives visible feedback within 100ms, even if the underlying operation takes longer.

simultaneousAttentionElements.description: The maximum number of UI elements competing for the user's attention at any single point in the flow (choices, notifications, animated elements, form fields visible at once).

hasPowerUserPath.description: Whether the flow offers an accelerated path for repeat/expert users (keyboard shortcuts, batch actions, skip-ahead, saved defaults). Omitting this is treated as false.
